results.summary_before: This is an 8-bit fully pipelined ALU that includes multiply, divide and barrel shifter functions along with flag and pipeline control logic. Operand A arrives on ui[0] to ui[7], operand B and the 3-bit opcode arrive on the bidirectional pins, and the 8-bit result appears on uo[0] to uo[7], with flags and pipeline enable also on the bidirectional pins. The design is self-contained and needs no external hardware beyond the standard demo board, though a logic analyzer or oscilloscope is suggested for detailed inspection. No silicon test results or detailed timing documentation are provided in the text.

results.summary_before: This is a 4-bit ALU implemented in Verilog that performs addition, subtraction, negation, multiplication, and bitwise AND, OR and XOR. Two 4-bit operands are supplied on the eight input pins, and the operation is selected by driving the corresponding bidirectional pin high. The 4-bit result appears on the upper four output pins, while the lower four output pins carry the upper half of the multiplication result. The documentation is brief and does not describe timing, testing or any silicon results.
